```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(nflfastR)
library(nflreadr)
```

```{r}
records <- read.csv("../../data/processed/team_records.csv")
```

```{r}
reg_success <- records %>% 
  mutate(win_pct = reg_wins / (reg_wins + reg_losses + reg_ties)) %>% 
  # making the percentile season-based, to account for some more context
  group_by(season) %>% 
  mutate(win_percentile = percent_rank(win_pct)) %>% 
  select(season, team, coach, offense, defense, win_pct, win_percentile)
```

```{r}
write.csv(reg_success, "../../data/processed/regular_season_success.csv")
```
